missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Век' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'наступил'. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine, marking the start of a century.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Век' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'пережил', matching the nominative. 'Целый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Века' is the genitive after 'памятник' to mean of the past century. 'Прошлого' agrees in the masculine genitive.

missions.phrase: До нашего века дошло мало книг.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after 'до'. 'До века' uses the genitive 'века' after 'до' to mean up to our century. 'Книг' is the genitive plural after 'мало'.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a time frame. 'Века' is the genitive after 'концу' to mean by the end of the century. 'К концу' itself uses the dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'С веком' uses the instrumental 'веком' after 'с' to mean with each century. 'Каждым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.

missions.phrase: В двадцатом веке было много войн.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В веке' uses the prepositional 'веке' after 'в' to set the era. 'Двадцатом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В веке' again takes the prepositional 'веке' to frame the present era. 'Нашем' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Века' is the nominative plural of 'век', the subject of 'прошли'. The plural takes the stressed -а ending typical of such masculine nouns.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural of duration. 'Веками' is the instrumental plural of 'век', used adverbially to mean for centuries. A vivid way to express long duration.
